text:
maria: quick q — after yesterday's key rotation some clients are hitting 403 when they omit `X-Project` header. should the server infer org/project from the api-key during rotation? cc @chris @alex
chris: we purposely implemented an implicit fallback for legacy org-scoped keys, but new project-scoped keys must include `X-Project`. do you know if the rotated keys were promoted to project-scope?
alex: fyi i saw this in e2e: SDK 2.1.0 only sets `X-Project` when the client explicitly called `setProject()`. a lot of apps relied on implicit org inference.
sam: infra perspective: we only accept fallback if the key metadata says org-scoped. if key is project-scoped we reject. logs show `403: project header required` — the message is pretty generic. can we make it clearer?
maria: PR #842 adds a clearer error and telemetry. question: change status code to 400/401/403? thoughts? @jeff @deploy-bot
jeff: prefer to keep 401/403 semantics. missing auth -> 401 if totally unauthenticated, but this is insufficient scope so 403 is correct. suggestion: keep 403, update text to `missing X-Project for project-scoped key` and add telemetry tag `auth.missing_project`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary window scheduled 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC if PR merged. :rocket:
chris: another gotcha — some proxies (old envoy config) rewrite headers and can strip or rename `x-project` to `x_project`. we've seen that cause silent failures. add ingress test to prevent regressions. :eyes:
maria: plan = 1) update error msg + telemetry, 2) add e2e/ingress test for header normalization, 3) ship small SDK patch to always emit `X-Project` when org present. aiming for EOD patch and canary 3/18. any blockers?
sam: no blockers from infra, i'll hook up an alert for 403 auth spikes during canary.
alex: pinging mobile-eng — mobile SDK may not set project header by default; if so we need a minor release. @mobile-eng
mobile-eng: noted, will check SDK behavior and open a minor patch if needed.
maria: cool. thanks everyone — i'll update PR and add checklist in the description. :thumbsup:
